Quiet, Convenient, and affordable: the perfect balance! This charming and well-maintained townhome offers the ideal blend of serenity and convenience. Nestled in a quiet, elevated spot with nice views, this home provides a 'tucked-away' feel while keeping everything you need within easy reach. The layout is simple, open, incredibly easy to live in; and features a warm, inviting fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings. Located just steps away from downtown dining, shopping, and coffee shops. Ideally situated near the military base, this gem is perfect for low-maintenance living and for a quick commute. Move-in ready. Don't wait, book your tour today!

1 full bath, 1 half bath
